Belváros-Lipótváros (5. kerület) — Budapest, Hungary

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Budapest's historic downtown core — Váci utca, the Parliament, the riverside promenade — and by a wide margin the single most tourist-trafficked district in the city. A July 2025 crime-hotspot map built from the prior month's citywide police data named District V alongside VI, VII, VIII, IX, X and XV as the districts with the most recorded thefts, and specifically flagged Váci utca, Deák Ferenc tér and the Great Ring Road as frequent hotspots for theft and pickpocketing; roughly 500 thefts and 36 robberies were recorded across Budapest in the preceding month. Heavy legitimate foot traffic all day keeps this at caution level in daylight, but the sheer concentration of tourists and reported theft activity pushes the rating to red after dark. Sources checked: Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map, thefts/robberies).
